items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Cedric Haywood was with that band

ctx.x: No, he was playing guitar, wasn't he?

Well, he was playing piano, but what made him go get a guitar, because Cedric played the piano, and they had to alternate, and Bill wanted to be on the stand staff, so he went to the pawn shop and bought him a tenor guitar, four string, to learn it to sit on the band and play. He wanted to be in the band; he didn't want to be off and play the piano on certain things. That was his situation.

But now, let me get back to you ... we played all the after parties. For every big band that came in to Houston, we had maybe two a month. The Luntzwood Luntz Ford band was one of them that come in -- the Duke Ellington Band, Count Basie, the Millinder Claude Hopkins, the Tiny Bradshaws, the Lucky Milliner -- we played all the after parties. Now what we did -- the after parties didn't start until after midnight, but we had access of going up to hear to go up and hearing all the bands opened till midnight --…
